Our modular infrastructure for digital mental health delivery – called JMIS – can handle every element of managing a mental health service, from appointment booking to analytics.
end of heading, Our Story, level 2
is a clinical services and digital infrastructure provider built to improve how mental health care is delivered, managed, and scaled across modern healthcare systems.
NHS services, independent providers, and employers
to reduce waiting times and improve patient outcomes.
By combining high-quality clinical services with modern digital systems, we bring structure to healthcare pathways.

Our platform enables services to move beyond fragmented, manual processes. From referral and triage through to clinician matching, care delivery, and outcomes tracking, it provides the infrastructure needed to manage entire pathways – not just individual appointments.
Alongside this, we deliver regulated clinical services through a network of over
, supporting people across a wide range of mental health and neurodiversity needs, including anxiety, depression, trauma, and ADHD.
This dual approach – infrastructure and delivery
– allows services to improve immediately through additional clinical capacity, while also implementing the systems needed to reduce long-term pressure on waiting lists and workforce.

Today, Dr-Julian supports NHS Talking Therapies services, national programmes such as Practitioner Health and Op COURAGE, independent providers including Vita Health Group and Alliance Psychology, and ICB-led initiatives such as Cumbria’s WorkWell programme.
We are not building another point solution or standalone service.
We are building the infrastructure that allows mental health systems to function more effectively — for clinicians, services, and the people who rely on them.
end of heading, Leadership Team, level 2
